fabrishot.config.title: Fabrishot
fabrishot.config.custom_file_name.toolti:
Use %time% for the time,
 %world% for world or server name
fabrishot.config.delay.tooltip: Frames to wait after resizing. Tweak for better exposure with shaders
fabrishot.config.flashback.unavailable: ✗ Flashback not detected — WebP/TIFF/AVIF will fall back to PNG
fabrishot.config.jpg_color_sampling.tool: 4:4:4 = best colour accuracy, 4:2:0 = smallest file size
fabrishot.config.webp_lossless.tooltip: Ignore quality slider; encode without any quality loss
fabrishot.config.webp_quality.tooltip: Higher = better quality (100 = best, only used when lossless is off)
fabrishot.config.tiff_compression.toolti: LZW provides the best balance of size and compatibility
fabrishot.config.tiff_color_sampling.too: RGB = lossless colour; YUV 4:4:4 = best chroma accuracy
fabrishot.config.avif_crf.tooltip: Lower = better quality (0 = best, 63 = worst). Default: 24
fabrishot.config.avif_tune.tooltip: SSIM: optimises for perceptual quality; PSNR: optimises for peak signal-to-noise ratio
fabrishot.config.avif_color_sampling.too: 4:4:4 = best colour accuracy, 4:2:0 = smallest file size
fabrishot.config.color_space_mode.toolti: FOLLOW_IRIS: reads from Iris settings; CUSTOM: pick manually; SRGB: safe default
fabrishot.config.stack_count.tooltip: Number of screenshots to capture and merge together (2-64)
fabrishot.config.stack_interval.tooltip: Ticks to wait between each frame capture (1 tick = 1/20 sec)
fabrishot.config.stack_mode.tooltip:
AVERAGE: long-exposure smoothing
MAXIMUM: lighten / star trails
MINIMUM: darken
MEDIAN: remove moving objects
